offers_products.reason: Cloud-based HCM software (payroll, HR, time and labor, talent management) sold as SaaS is its main offering.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from SaaS subscriptions; implementation and dedicated specialist support are incidental to the software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells HR and payroll software only to employers, not to individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are small, medium and enterprise companies across healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing, retail and education.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription payroll and HR software billed per employee each pay period; clients stay for years.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll and HR compliance are essential and run continuously, so customers rarely cut them; headcount changes only modestly affect fees.

big_ticket.reason: Sold as ongoing per-employee subscription fees, not a large one-time purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the cloud software platform and automation, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves small, medium and enterprise firms; mostly small and mid-sized employers, such as a franchisee, a park district and an eye practice.

asset_heavy.reason: Software business needing development and data centers or cloud capacity, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Large-customer answer is a judgment call, since the customer base spans small to enterprise employers.
